---
name: "meeting"
description: "Prepare or summarize a meeting — a prep card before; decisions, action items, open questions after."
disableModelInvocation: true
---

Use `meeting-prep-card` or `meeting-summary` (both from plugin `superuser`) with the `meeting-prep` agent: **$ARGUMENTS**

- `prep` — build the one-page card before the meeting
- `summary` — capture decisions and action items right after
